g.text: Migrating extension "old-ext" to a new repository, renaming to "test-ext", and installing updates.
The extension you are about to install may have been created by a third-party developer and sourced
from a public repository. M31A maintainers do not vet, endorse, or guarantee the functionality or
security of extensions. Please carefully inspect any extension and its source code before installing
to understand the permissions it requires and the actions it may perform.
